ledger.x: 1558: 'a Portuguese garrison was established on Male' (the Portuguese had arrived in the Maldives in 1507).
1573: 'a popular revolt led by Muhammad Thakurufaanu al-Auzam drove the Portuguese away.'
1953: 'a third constitution was created in 1953', which dissolved the sultanate in favour of a presidential republic; the page gives no month.
1954: the referendum 'resulted in the restoration of the Sultanate in 1954'.
1968: the final referendum 'resulted in the establishment of a presidential republic, putting an end to the 815-year-old sultanate'; the page gives no day or month.

certainty.note: A scatter of atolls; the grid resolves the whole country to one cell, so only the dates carry information.
